home.title: Your engagements
home.adminNote: Platform administrator — you can see every project.
home.emptyAdmin: No projects yet. Create a client and a project under Administration.
home.emptyUser: You have not been given access to a project yet. Ask a project owner or a platform administrator.
project.dashboardBody: Plan vs actual and BR/FR status per workstream arrive with the build slices. The business function chart and requirements come first (slice 1).
program.subtitle: Program view — each project keeps its own data.
program.rollupSoon: Roll-up figures arrive with the build slices.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Platform administrators only. Creating a project grants nobody access — give access from the project's Access screen.
admin.name: Name
admin.deactivateBody: {name} will be signed out on their next click and cannot sign in again. Their history stays.
admin.adminBodyGrant: {name} will see every client's projects. Give the reason — it is kept in the audit log.
admin.adminBodyRemove: {name} will no longer see the projects they are not assigned to, or the administration screens. Choose what they become and give the reason — it is kept in the audit log.
home.kindNote.USER: You can open and edit the projects you are assigned to, and any project open to all staff.
home.kindNote.VIEWER: You can open and read the projects you are assigned to, and any project open to all staff.
access.title: Who can open this project
access.subtitle: Platform administrators see every project. Other staff see the projects they are assigned to, and any project an administrator has opened to all staff.
access.adminOnly: Only this project's admins and platform administrators can see and change who has access.
access.restrictFtcOnly: Only a platform administrator can limit this project to its assigned consultants or open it to all staff.
access.unrestricted: Open to all staff — every staff member can open it: {users} users (can edit) and {viewers} viewers (read only).
access.restricted: Assigned consultants only — only the members below and platform administrators can open it.
access.restrictTitle: Limit this project to its assigned consultants?
access.unrestrictTitle: Open this project to all staff?
access.loses: Lose access on their next click: {list}
access.membersNote: Members are the consultants assigned to this project. Project admins manage this list. Members decide who can open the project while it is limited to assigned consultants; a project admin can manage members whether it is limited or open.
access.viewerOnlyView: Viewers can only be given read-only access.
access.removeBody: {name} loses access to this project on their next click. To give it back, add them again.
access.removeBodyOpen: {name} is removed from the member list. While the project is open to all staff they can still open it, as every staff member can.
admin.comesBack: These project roles come back into force with this change:
admin.comesBackNone: No project role comes back into force.
admin.makeUserBody: {name} will be able to edit every project open to all staff, and the projects they are assigned to with edit access, from their next click.
access.levelDropsNote: Marked members keep only read access once the project is limited. If they should keep editing, set their level to Can edit in the member list.
access.createdNote: Project created. Only its assigned consultants can open it, and it has none yet — add them below.
